prompt_inputs.goal: Build muscle mass and strength through proper nutrition for weightlifting

solution_criteria: Meal plan contains exactly 4-5 meals distributed throughout the day
Total daily protein is at least 1.7g per kilogram of body weight (minimum 144g)
Protein is distributed evenly across meals (roughly 25-35g per meal)
Total daily calories support muscle building (approximately 3000-3500 calories)
Includes calorie-dense whole foods suitable for strength athletes (e.g., lean meats, grains, nuts, oils)
task_description: Write a compact, concise 1 day meal plan for a single athlete
scenario: Testing with a strength/power athlete (weightlifter) emphasizing protein distribution and caloric density for muscle building

prompt_inputs.goal: Optimize performance and recovery for competitive soccer

solution_criteria: Meal plan covers all 3 meals and includes snacks with adequate protein (minimum 1.6g per kg body weight daily for athlete recovery)
All meals are 100% vegan with no animal-derived ingredients
Plan is concise and fits on a single page with clear meal names and basic macronutrient guidance
task_description: Write a compact, concise 1 day meal plan for a single athlete
scenario: Testing with a sport-specific dietary constraint scenario (vegan soccer player) requiring nutrient-complete meals while accommodating ethical preferences

prompt_inputs.goal: Marathon training with high carbohydrate intake and meal timing around long run

solution_criteria: Meal plan is formatted as a single day with clear meal timing
Includes high carbohydrate content appropriate for endurance athlete (55-65% of calories)
Contains pre-training, during-training (if applicable), and post-training nutrition guidance
All meals and snacks are realistic and practical to prepare/consume
task_description: Write a compact, concise 1 day meal plan for a single athlete
scenario: Testing with a high-performance endurance athlete (marathon runner) requiring high carbohydrate intake and specific timing around training windows
